summary: Teacher-scoped authorization is enforced on every mutating handler; a High-severity gap (reviewAuthoredLessonHandler lacked an ownership check at baseline 868b08b8) was fixed at 828a751f and is now proven by a new adversarial test (f9038201). Sanitization, approval-aware publish gating, and student assignment/enrollment visibility are all sound. No unresolved High-severity security findings.
nonblocking_findings: Low: loadAuthoredLesson selects the latest version via versions[versions.length - 1] rather than an explicit sort by version/createdAt. Relies on Convex insertion ordering; a persistence-semantics fragility, not a proven security blocker, and not introduced in Phase 2. File: apps/integrated-math-3/convex/teacher/content-authoring.ts
